system.description:
Unique. This Stance counts as a Taijutsu Stance when gaining it as a result of a Class feature or Feat, and while you are unarmed.

You have learned how to strike with ruthless efficiency while you bring about death.

Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Assassin Weapons;

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and slashing and counts as an Assassin Weapon for all effects and abilities of this stance. If wearing Iron Claws this instead becomes 1d8.

While hidden from a creature, weapon attacks and unarmed attacks you make against them pierce half of their DR.

The first unarmed or weapon attack you make against a creature you are hidden from grants you +1 Critical threat range for that attack.

Beginning at 5th level, Once per turn, in place of one of your attacks granted by the Attack action, you can perform an Assassination Strike.

Assassination Strike. Make an unarmed attack or weapon attack using your Assassin Weapon against a creature you are hidden from. This attack maximized the Assassin Weapons damage die. After a successful attack resolves you can spend your Bonus Action to disengage.

Beginning at 10th level, Once per turn, when you disengage as a result of using Assassination Strike, you can spend your Reaction to attempt to Hide again, provided cover or concealment is available.
system.requirement: Iron Claws, or a weapon with the Deadly or Hidden weapon property.

activities.label: Assassination Strike
activities.text: Against a creature you are hidden from.
